DT0001.summary: pubspec.yaml is missing at the project root.
DT0001.remediation: Run Dartitect from a Dart or Flutter project root.

DT0002.summary: A declared scan directory could not be read.
DT0002.remediation: Check filesystem permissions and scan again.

DT0003.summary: A symbolic link was skipped by the scanner.
DT0003.remediation: Keep declared source roots inside the project root.

DT0004.summary: A local suppression lacks a justification.

DT1001.remediation: Move framework code to a presentation boundary.

DT1002.summary: Domain code imports data or infrastructure.

DT1003.remediation: Reverse the dependency through an application contract.

DT1004.remediation: Pass values or narrow callbacks instead of BuildContext.

DT1005.summary: Presentation code imports an infrastructure client.
DT1005.remediation: Inject a service or repository contract.

DT1006.summary: A forbidden architecture framework was detected.
DT1006.remediation: Use constructor injection and native listenables.

DT1007.summary: A package imports another package private src library.

DT1017.summary: A dependency is universally prohibited or has an active contextual conflict.
DT1017.remediation: Use the architectural alternative or choose one instrumentation path documented by the ledger.

DT1018.summary: An ecosystem overlay is invalid, global, incomplete, expired, or does not cover every owner.
DT1018.remediation: Add a consumer-owned scoped path, owner, reason, expiry, and any required direct owners.

DT1019.summary: An overlapping state, provider, or service-location runtime is installed.
DT1019.remediation: Adopt incrementally, retain consumer ownership, and prevent provider types, service location, or duplicate writers from crossing concrete boundaries.

DT1020.summary: A generated model output is absent, stale, or orphaned.
DT1020.remediation: Review `dartitect model sync`, then apply and commit outputs plus manifest.

DT1022.remediation: Review consumer bytes; no force-adoption is supported.

DT1023.summary: A model generation journal requires explicit recovery.
DT1023.remediation: Review state, then run `dartitect model sync --apply`.

DT1024.summary: Android launch background resources are missing or invalid.

DT1025.summary: iOS launch storyboard resources are missing or disconnected.

DT1030.summary: A DartitectValue model has no unnamed primary constructor.
DT1030.remediation: Review `dartitect model migrate primary`, then apply the semantic edit.

DT1031.summary: A traditional model constructor cannot be migrated automatically without changing semantics.
DT1031.remediation: Review constructor bodies, initializers, documentation, and field ownership manually.

DT1032.summary: A modeling annotation has the wrong semantic library identity.
DT1032.remediation: Import the annotation from the public dartitect_modeling entrypoint.

DT1033.summary: An annotated modeling class is not concrete and final.
DT1033.remediation: Use a concrete final data carrier or remove the modeling capability.

DT1034.summary: A modeling library does not own exactly one deterministic generated part.
DT1034.remediation: Declare the expected .dartitect.g.dart part once in the defining unit.

DT1035.summary: A modeling declaration has an invalid primary, inheritance, or mixin shape.
DT1035.remediation: Use the required unnamed primary constructor and generated mixin contract.

DT1036.summary: A model field is not a public typed named final primary parameter.
DT1036.remediation: Move immutable field ownership to the primary constructor.

DT1037.summary: A model retains a mutable collection interface.
DT1037.remediation: Use a consumer-owned immutable value collection.

DT1038.summary: A field collides with a generated modeling member name.

DT1039.summary: Analyzer could not resolve a required modeling element or library.
DT1039.remediation: Resolve syntax, package configuration, and dependency diagnostics first.

DT1040.summary: Modeling capability or field metadata is invalid or ambiguous.
DT1040.remediation: Keep capabilities independent and make names and hooks explicit.

DT1041.summary: A modeling class body retains instance state or a traditional constructor.
DT1041.remediation: Keep model instance fields in the primary constructor and behavior or statics in the body.

DT1042.summary: An unrelated Analyzer error prevents safe model rendering.
DT1042.remediation: Resolve the underlying Analyzer diagnostic before generation.

DT1043.summary: A JSON field type or hook pair cannot be rendered safely.
DT1043.remediation: Use an explicit scalar or immutable collection, or provide both consumer-owned codec hooks.

DT1044.summary: A mapper target, field compatibility, or converter hook cannot be proven lossless.
DT1044.remediation: Use semantically assignable fields or exact consumer-owned static Result converters in each required direction.

DT1045.summary: A disposable temporary is passed directly to a borrowing host .value constructor.
DT1045.remediation: Retain and dispose the value at an explicit owner boundary, or use the host's owning constructor.

DT2001.remediation: Correct the reported JSON Pointer without discarding unknown keys.

DT2002.summary: An unknown config key was preserved.
DT2002.remediation: Check whether it belongs to a newer SDK.

DT2100.summary: The Dart SDK is below the supported floor.

DT2101.summary: An enabled adapter dependency is missing.
DT2101.remediation: Add the adapter or remove it from enabledAdapters.

DT2102.summary: ObjectBox is enabled in a project containing web.
DT2102.remediation: Exclude ObjectBox code from web builds.

DT2103.summary: A memory storage context is selected for a release build.
DT2103.remediation: Select an explicit durable provider for every release target.

DT2200.summary: The opt-in deep analyzer check failed.

DT2201.summary: The opt-in deep analyzer check timed out.
DT2201.remediation: Run the analyzer directly and inspect its performance.

DT2300.remediation: Review violations and recreate the baseline.

DT2400.summary: Managed Codex skills are not installed.

DT2401.summary: A Dartitect skill lacks its management manifest.

DT2501.summary: The Dartitect analyzer plugin is not enabled.

DT2502.summary: A stale transaction artifact requires recovery.
